Next, I will determine the point group of ethane.

Ethane is a relatively simple molecule, and in its staggered conformation, it has several symmetry elements. It has:
- An S6 improper rotation axis (a combination of a C6 rotation and a perpendicular reflection through a horizontal plane).
- Three C2 axes perpendicular to the main C-C bond axis.
- Several σd planes (dihedral planes).
